children: Blue Chip Capital Group Inc. reported results for the third quarter ended August 31, 2026, recording no revenue and a net loss of $0.9M, or a diluted loss per share of $0.0084, compared with a net loss of $3.96M and a loss per share of $0.0454 in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue: $0 for 3Q 2026 (no revenue recorded for the three months ended August 31, 2026 or the year-ago quarter).
Net income: Net loss of $0.90M for 3Q 2026, versus net loss of $3.96M in the year-ago quarter (3Q 2025).
Diluted EPS: Loss per share $0.0084 for 3Q 2026, versus loss per share $0.0454 in the year-ago quarter.
Operations: The company has not generated any revenue since inception and reported no revenue for the latest fiscal periods.
Capital raising: Blue Chip Capital raised $750,000 via private convertible notes in the quarter to support ongoing operations and platform buildout.
Expenses: Operating expenses declined materially year-over-year, driven by lower legal and accounting costs and reduced stock-based inducement expenses.
Strategy: Management is building a portfolio of subsidiaries under the Raisewise USA brand to offer crowdfunding services in multiple foreign jurisdictions.
Outlook: Management plans to update its registration statement and is targeting $1M–$5M in additional capital to sustain and expand operations.
